_comment: Hand-authored. Bank 3: the password decoder, field build and drawing ($8516-$870C). The generators subtract these.

regions.name: PASSWORD DECODER (`$8516`; called by the editor `$887F` when 32 characters are entered): wait
regions.description: `JSR $C045`: wait for the tile decompressor (the staging area `$0100-$011D` is about to be used).

regions.name: PASSWORD DECODER (`$8516`; called by the editor `$887F` when 32 characters are entered): the seed
regions.description: `$19` := (`$042F` >> 4) OR (`$0430` << 2), + `$1D`: **byte 23 of the stream, held in the last two characters, plus 29**.

regions.name: PASSWORD DECODER (`$8516`; called by the editor `$887F` when 32 characters are entered): set-up
regions.description: `$17` (output index), `$14` (input offset), `$18` (mismatch count) := 0; `$16` := 8 groups.

regions.name: PASSWORD DECODER (`$8516`; called by the editor `$887F` when 32 characters are entered): a group
regions.description: `LDX $14 / JSR $85BB`: four characters -> three bytes in `$0403-$0405`; X := the output index.

regions.name: PASSWORD DECODER (`$8516`; called by the editor `$887F` when 32 characters are entered): a byte
regions.description: `LDA $0403,Y`; **index 23 (X = `$17`) is not XORed; every other byte is XORed with the seed, which then decrements.**

regions.name: PASSWORD DECODER (`$8516`; called by the editor `$887F` when 32 characters are entered): store and compare
regions.description: `$011E + X` := the byte; compared with the state buffer `$0439 + X`; a difference counts in `$18`.

regions.name: PASSWORD DECODER (`$8516`; called by the editor `$887F` when 32 characters are entered): next
regions.description: Three bytes a group; the input offset += 4; eight groups. RUN: the group loop gave the encoder's bytes back.

regions.name: PASSWORD DECODER (`$8516`; called by the editor `$887F` when 32 characters are entered): which mode?
regions.description: `$0400` zero (the check mode of `$8376`) goes to `$8574`; non-zero (entering a password) to the back door at `$857A`.

regions.name: PASSWORD DECODER (`$8516`; called by the editor `$887F` when 32 characters are entered): check mode: the same as the game's own?
regions.description: No mismatches in `$18`: carry clear, accepted; any: `SEC`. **RUN: the password built from a state is accepted against that state and refused after one change (attack 2 -> 3).**

regions.name: PASSWORD DECODER (`$8516`; called by the editor `$887F` when 32 characters are entered): refused
regions.description: `SEC / RTS`.

regions.name: PASSWORD DECODER (`$8516`; called by the editor `$887F` when 32 characters are entered): the TGL back door
regions.description: The first three characters against `$8513` (`13 06 0B`: T, G, L) and **every other of the 32 characters zero**: `$2F` := 0, `$30` := 2 (a TGL game), carry clear - **the checksum is skipped**. RUN: `T G L` + 29 blanks was accepted (`$30` = 2, `$2F` = 0); the same with one stray character in the last place was refused.

regions.name: PASSWORD DECODER (`$8516`; called by the editor `$887F` when 32 characters are entered): the checksum
regions.description: The sum with the carries chained (`ADC`, no `CLC` in the loop) of the 22 bytes `$011E-$0133` (indices 0-21), plus index 23 (`$0135`, the raw seed byte), compared with index 22 (`$0134`): unequal refuses.

regions.name: PASSWORD DECODER (`$8516`; called by the editor `$887F` when 32 characters are entered): accepted: the state
regions.description: The 24 bytes `$011E-$0135` are copied to `$0439-$0450`; `CLC / RTS`. RUN: 60 random states built by `$83AE` / `$860E` were accepted and came back equal; a changed character in each was refused (60 of 60).

regions.name: PASSWORD UNPACK (`$85BB`): four characters
regions.description: Four characters from `$0411 + X` to `$0403-$0406`; the first three AND `$3F`.

regions.name: PASSWORD UNPACK (`$85BB`): byte 0
regions.description: `$0403` := char 0 OR (char 1 low two bits << 6).

regions.name: PASSWORD UNPACK (`$85BB`): byte 1
regions.description: `$0404` := (char 1 >> 2) OR (char 2 low four bits << 4).

regions.name: PASSWORD UNPACK (`$85BB`): byte 2
regions.description: `$0405` := (char 2 >> 4) OR (char 3 << 2); `RTS`. **The standard 6-bit unpack, four characters into three bytes.**

regions.name: PASSWORD BUILD (`$860E`): a seed
regions.description: `$0450` := a random byte (`$C0EA`); wait for the decompressor.

regions.name: PASSWORD BUILD (`$860E`): the checksum
regions.description: `$044F` := the carry-chained sum of `$0439-$044E` (indices 0-21) + the seed.

regions.name: PASSWORD BUILD (`$860E`): the encryption
regions.description: X = 30..1: `$00FF + X` := `$0438 + X` XOR the seed, the seed incrementing: **index k is XORed with seed + 29 - k**, which is what the decoder's decrementing seed (byte 23 + 29) undoes.

regions.name: PASSWORD BUILD (`$860E`): the seed in the clear
regions.description: `$0117` (index 23) := the seed itself.

regions.name: PASSWORD BUILD (`$860E`): 32 characters
regions.description: For each of the 32 characters `JSR $8654` and store it in `$0411 + Y`.

regions.name: PASSWORD BUILD (`$860E`): return
regions.description: `RTS`.

regions.name: PASSWORD BUILD (`$860E`): the next 6 bits (`$8654`)
regions.description: The 24 bytes `$0100-$0118` are one long shift register: six times `ROR` through all of them (X = 24..1) collecting the bits that fall out in A; A >> 2 is the character (0-63).

regions.name: PASSWORD FIELD DRAWING (`$866B`): draw the field
PASSWORD FIELD DRAWING (`$866B`): return
regions.description: `RTS`.

regions.name: PASSWORD FIELD DRAWING (`$866B`): where character X goes (`$8681`)
regions.description: X under 16 is the first row, otherwise the second (Y = 1: +`$40`) and X - 16; then X + 1 for each group of four passed (at 4, 8, 12): **the characters are shown in four groups of four with a blank between them, 16 + 3 columns, two rows.**

regions.name: PASSWORD FIELD DRAWING (`$866B`): draw one character (`$86A8`)
regions.description: A 5-byte PPU queue item (`JSR $C04B`, `JSR $C03C`): `$82` (a run of 2 with the address increment 32: a vertical pair), the address (`$18` + column, + `$40` per row), then the two tiles: the top `$20` (blank), or `$AE` for the lowercase letters (their umlaut dots), and the glyph:

regions.name: PASSWORD FIELD DRAWING (`$866B`): the glyph
regions.description: A character 0-25 is `A`-`Z` (+`$41`); 26-29 `0`-`3` (+`$16`); 30-55 the lowercase letters (+`$63`: tiles `$81-$9A`, with the dots `$AE` above); 56-61 `4`-`9` (-4); 62 and 63 the tiles `$9B` and `$9C` (`!` and `?`).

regions.name: PASSWORD FIELD DRAWING (`$866B`): store the tiles
regions.description: `$0104` := the glyph, `$0103` := Y (the top tile); `LDX $13`; `JMP $C03F` (`$D6F7`: the item is complete).
